name: Alphamab Oncology
summary: Alphamab Oncology, a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and commercialization of biotherapeutics for cancer treatment in the People's Republic of China. It offers KN035, an injectable PD-L1 inhibitor for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable or metastatic microsatellite instability-high/efficient mismatch repair advanced solid tumors under the ENWEIDA brand.
